proof.text: Fix an object $U\to X$ of $X_{\mathrm{et}}$. The family $\{\varphi_i:V_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ is a covering of the object $X$ of $X_{\mathrm{et}}$, and $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ is a site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], so by the base-change axiom (iii) of a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] the fibre products $U_i=U\times_XV_i$ exist in $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ (computed as scheme-theoretic fibre products) and $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ is a covering of $U$. The second projection $U_i\to V_i$ is an $X$-morphism of etale $X$-schemes, so $U_i\to V_i$ is an object of the slice site $X_{\mathrm{et}}/V_i$, and the section group of $F|_{V_i}$ on it is $F(U_i)$. Since $F|_{V_i}$ is the zero sheaf, $F(U_i)=0$ for every $i$. When $I$ is empty this step is vacuous (then $X$ and $U$ are empty and the covering of $U$ is the empty family).

proof.text: A sheaf of modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ is in particular an abelian sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category; def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], so for the covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ of Step 1 the restriction map $F(U)\to\prod_{i\in I}F(U_i)$ is the first arrow of an equalizer diagram and hence injective. Its target is $\prod_i0=0$ by Step 1 (for $I=\emptyset$ it is the empty product, also $0$). Therefore $F(U)=0$.

source.place: Proof, first sentence “The assertion is local on $X$” and last sentence “Both assertions are local on the site”

proof.text: Step 2 holds for every object $U$ of $X_{\mathrm{et}}$, so every section module of $F$ is $0$. Morphisms of sheaves of modules are natural transformations with linear components [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], so for every sheaf of modules $G$ there is exactly one morphism $G\to F$ and exactly one morphism $F\to G$ (each component has source or target $0$). Hence $F$ is a zero object, the zero sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$.

title: An etale module sheaf vanishing on a covering family is zero
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{\varphi_i:V_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering family of $X$ in its small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], that is, a finite or arbitrary jointly surjective family of etale morphisms; for example a finite family of open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] whose images cover $X$, and, when $X$ is empty, the empty family. Let $F$ be a sheaf of modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and write $F|_{V_i}$ for its restriction to the slice site $X_{\mathrm{et}}/V_i$, whose sections over an etale $X$-morphism $W\to V_i$ are $F(W)$. If every restriction $F|_{V_i}$ is the zero sheaf, then $F$ is the zero sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$.
